# Preface {.unnumbered}

Welcome to **Creative Coding** — a course that teaches you to program a
computer by making things you can *see*. Instead of only printing text on a
black screen, you'll draw shapes, build small pictures, and grow them into
interactive artworks. You don't need any programming experience to start: the
course begins at zero and builds up step by step.

This book is written once in [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and published two
ways from the same source:

- a **book website** with a chapter sidebar and prev/next navigation, and
- a **single PDF** handout, with each chapter starting on its own page.

Use the sidebar to move between chapters, or read straight through. Along the
way you'll open hands-on exercises in a browser-based playground — no
installation, just a link.

> **Tip:** Run `quarto preview` in the project folder to get a live-reloading
> book while you edit.
